chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Musicians who need a drink to work: Jay McShann
summary: Humes grows disgusted when Jay McShann gets drinking, though he still plays wonderfully. Dance laments how many musicians harm themselves this way.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: And he used to have himself a little taste now and then.

Well, I don't know, sometimes it seems like a lot of them can't work unless they have a little taste. Because sometimes I get disgusted with Jay. As well as he plays. And then when he gets to drinking he don't know what the hell you singing.(laughter)
O yeah. 'Hooty'. But honey he goes on, he plays so --- I mean you catch him ... (Laughs)
Yeah. It's a terrible how many musicians harm themselves like that.
